usedFor: Kuration builds research projects, and Slack receives a post through “Send Message” whenever a project is created or updated.

bestTemplate.name: “When a project is created or updated” in Kuration, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Your team sees each project change in a channel, with no one checking Kuration.

watchOut: An automation post to a Slack channel waits for your approval, and the Kuration trigger fires on updates as well.
